title: New public phishing datasets and benchmarks
prompt_focus: Identify public phishing-detection datasets, feeds, and benchmarks (URL lists, HTML/DOM corpora, screenshots, brand logo sets) released or substantially updated in the last 90 days.

title: Active phishing campaigns impersonating {brand}
prompt_focus: Find recent public threat-intelligence reports describing phishing campaigns that impersonate {brand} and list the phishing URLs or domains used.

title: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing kits
prompt_focus: Find recent public reports on adversary-in-the-middle and phishing-as-a-service kits (for example Tycoon 2FA, EvilProxy, Mamba 2FA) that publish landing-page URLs or domains as IOCs.

title: CERT and government phishing advisories
prompt_focus: Find recent CERT, CISA, NCSC, or other government advisories that publish phishing URLs or domains as indicators of compromise.

title: Banking and payment credential phishing
prompt_focus: Find recent public reports on credential-phishing pages targeting {brand} customers, including the published phishing URLs or domains.

title: Brand typosquat and lookalike domain registrations
prompt_focus: Find recent public research or feeds documenting typosquat and lookalike domain registrations used for phishing against {brand}, including the listed domains.
